'''Chapter 1164''' is titled "Davy Blood".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page]] Request: "[[Perona]] chasing a rabbit with a watch" by PN Tomari Shinonome.

==Short Summary==
[[Rocks D. Xebec|Rocks]] resists his [[Demons|transformation]] and taunts [[Nerona Imu]] about [[Davy D. Jones]] and [[Joy Boy]], which enrages Imu. Imu declares that he will subjugate [[Elbaph]] and [[Harald]], much to Rocks' anger, and once again tells him to kill his [[Davy Family|family]] as Rocks' transformation completes. Rocks, in his demonic form, attacks [[Kaidou]] and [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]], and clashes with [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]], destroying the mountain on [[God Valley]]. Rocks' nearly kills his own [[Eris|wife]] and [[Marshall D. Teach|son]], but [[Bartholomew Kuma|Kuma]] manages to [[Nikyu Nikyu no Mi|teleport]] them and himself away from God Valley. Rocks kills several people till [[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]] and [[Gol D. Roger|Roger]] confront him to stop him. They hear Rocks' [[Voice of All Things|voice]], begging them to kill him.

==Long Summary==
Everyone watches as [[Rocks D. Xebec|Rocks]] screams in pain due to the transformation process, but surprisingly, Rocks was doing his best to resist transforming, to a point [[Nerona Imu|Imu]] called him persistent. Rocks tells Imu not to underestimate the strength of a [[Humans|human being]], and he proudly declares his belief that [[Davy D. Jones]] was once the [[King (Title)|king]] of the [[Blue Planet|world]]. Imu is enraged by Rocks' words and declares that Jones was never the king of anything, but the animosity between the two of them has nothing to do with Rocks. Rocks, however, does not believe that because of how panicked Imu seems to be over something as simple as a family name. Rocks asks Imu if he has been terrified for years at the thought that someone would [[Inherited Will|inherit]] Jones' will and fulfill the "promise" he spoke of. He then asks Imu what terrifies him more: Jones or [[Joy Boy]].

Imu demands Rocks silence himself and announces that once he eliminates him, "their" kind will never be seen again. Imu then tells Rocks that he has found the perfect soldiers, which are the [[giants]] of [[Elbaph]], as they are currently harmless and internally conflicted. Rocks becomes enraged and demands Imu leave [[Harald]] out of his plan because he only wants peace, but Imu says that Harald's desire for peace will allow him to mold Harald into the perfect puppet, just like he is molding him into one. Imu once again orders Rocks to end his own [[Davy Family|bloodline]] and everyone else on the [[God Valley|island]] as he slams him on the ground, thus completing the transformation.

[[Charlotte Linlin|Linlin]] and [[Kaidou]] get too close to Rocks wondering what happened to him, but Rocks stands up and declares there is blood he needs to exterminate. In an instant, Rocks grabs Kaidou and slams him into the mountain, prompting Linlin to attack him. Unfortunately, Rocks also easily dispatches her as well. [[Edward Newgate|Newgate]] stands his ground and matches Rocks' attack with his own, causing a shockwave so powerful it shatters the northeast mountain and causes it to crumble. After that, Rocks continued to chase after his wife and son.

The [[Marines]] are ordered to keep their distance from the island and prioritize the safe evacuation of the [[World Noble]]s. Everyone else continues to try and flee with their lives and whatever [[treasure]] they were able to secure. Elsewhere, [[Monkey D. Dragon|Dragon]] despairs over his inability to rescue baby [[Shanks]], while [[Emporio Ivankov|Ivankov]] tells [[Bartholomew Kuma|Kuma]] to stop as he has saved enough people, but Kuma insists there are more. [[John]] survives [[Ganzui]]'s attack and manages to escape with some treasure. Rocks, meanwhile, manages to reach [[Eris]] and [[Marshall D. Teach|Teach]]. When Eris sees him, Eris figures that Rocks lost his confrontation with Imu and apologizes for it, saying he did it to save them even though he was not ready. Regardless, Eris holds Teach closer to her and says they will jump into the [[Blue Sea|sea]] and swim away if that is what it takes to survive. Just as she reaches the shore, though, the Marines stationed open fire on her. Thankfully, both her and Teach are [[Nikyu Nikyu no Mi|teleported]] away by Kuma, who saw them earlier, before teleporting himself away. Rocks' slash ends up destroying the [[Marine Ships|ship]], though he still gets hit by the [[Firearm#Cannon|cannons]].

Seeing the fire in the distance, Imu orders Rocks to continue killing everyone else on the island. [[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]] and [[Gol D. Roger|Roger]] confront Rocks as they do not want him to hurt anymore of their people, but they see tears streaming down his face and they somehow [[Voice of All Things|hear]] his voice in their heads. Rocks begs to Garp and Roger to kill him, as the three begin the fated battle.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*While [[Rocks D. Xebec|Rocks]] fights to resist the ''Domi Reversi'', he proclaims that [[Davy D. Jones]] was the previous [[King (Title)|king]] of the [[Blue Planet|world]], utterly infuriating [[Nerona Imu|Imu]].
**As Imu tries to deny it, Rocks taunts him further by claiming Imu is afraid of [[Joy Boy]] and Davy Jones' "promise".
**Imu further elaborated that the reason why he wants to eliminate the Davy clan, is to make sure that Davy Jones never resurfaces to his world again.
**Imu counters that he has found the perfect soldiers this time, the [[Giants]] of [[Elbaph]] and their "pliable king".
**An angry Rocks demands that [[Harald]] be left alone, but succumbs to the ''Domi Reversi''.
**Worried, [[Charlotte Linlin|Linlin]] and [[Kaidou]] approach the [[Demons|demonized]] Rocks, who attacks and incapacitates them.
**[[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] tries to stop Rocks, but their clashing attacks causes the northeast mountain of [[God Valley]] to collapse on top of the nearby armadas.
*All the remaining [[Marines]], [[World Noble]]s, and [[pirate]]s evacuate the island en masse.
**[[Taro]] seems to have taken the [[treasure]] chest containing [[Shanks]].
**[[Shiki]] attacked [[Ganzui]], taking some of the treasure.
*Just as Rocks catches up to [[Marshall D. Teach|Teach]] and [[Eris]] and prepares to kill them, [[Bartholomew Kuma|Kuma]] [[Nikyu Nikyu no Mi|pushes]] them away at the last moment before fleeing himself.
*Imu then orders Rocks to kill any last remaining person on the island.
*[[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]] and [[Gol D. Roger|Roger]] confront Rocks.
**Garp and Roger [[Voice of All Things|hear]] Rocks begging them to kill him.
**Garp is confirmed to be capable of hearing the [[Voice of All Things]].
